Game Overview

At its heart, Put Out The Fire is a puzzle game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Put Out The Fire comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Put Out The Fire?

Put Out The Fire is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Put Out The Fire free to play?

Yes, Put Out The Fire is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
